title: Exact Q-space and Wick-square formulas for stationary diagonal quasi-free trials

quasi_free_formulas.trial_class: Let |psi_(alpha,s)|^2 dmu be the product Gaussian N(alpha_j,s_j) in the real covariance eigenbasis, with s_j>0 and equal sine/cosine factors on each nonzero Fourier pair so the covariance is translation invariant; restrict the mean to the constant zero mode a
quasi_free_formulas.free_cost: Direct logarithmic differentiation gives q0[psi_(alpha,s)]=(1/4)sum_j omega_j[alpha_j^2+(s_j-1)^2/s_j]
quasi_free_formulas.point_variance: The stationary centered fluctuation has constant point variance v_N=sum_j lambda_j s_j, while the free vacuum has C_N=sum_j lambda_j
quasi_free_formulas.wick_expectation: The exact normalized-torus expectation is F_C(a,v)=a^4+6a^2v+3v^2-6C(a^2+v)+9C^2
quasi_free_formulas.mean_optimization_low_variance: For 0<=v<=C, minimization over a^2>=0 gives a^2=3(C-v) and min_a F_C(a,v)=6v(2C-v)
quasi_free_formulas.mean_optimization_high_variance: For v>=C, the minimizer is a=0 and min_a F_C(a,v)=3(v-C)^2+6C^2
quasi_free_formulas.normalization_guard: All coordinates are real; pair-degenerate mode factors enforce translation invariance and prevent double counting conjugate complex Fourier modes
quasi_free_formulas.scope_guard: The formulas do not cover nonstationary or off-diagonal Gaussian covariance, nonconstant means beyond the coherent result, or non-Gaussian trial states
